rule: Conditions are ranked on the split being reported by (1) determination accuracy, highest first; ties broken by (2) macro-F1, highest first; (3) fabricated-citation rate, lowest first; (4) 95th-percentile response time, lowest first. The top-ranked condition is reported as the best model on that split. Its lead over the runner-up is tested with an exact McNemar test on accuracy (alpha = .05, two-sided); if that test is not significant the report states that the two are statistically indistinguishable. The rule was fixed on the development set; the test set confirms or overturns it. The no-retrieval baseline C0 is eligible.
statement: C ranks first under the pre-specified rule (accuracy 27.1%, macro-F1 0.214); its lead over C0 is 1.8 points (exact McNemar p = 0.481), so the two are statistically indistinguishable.
